candidates.claim: Switch sw-core-01 has a routed SVI for zone VLAN 10 (interface Vlan10 with IP 10.10.10.254/24), which the boundary policy forbids.
candidates.remediation: Remove the IP address from interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 so VLAN 10 exists only at layer 2.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: interface Vlan10 was added on sw-core-01 and is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added Vlan10 interface with the approved baseline by approving or reverting it.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: an ip address line was added under interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 and is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added Vlan10 IP address with the approved baseline by approving or reverting it.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: ip routing was enabled globally on sw-core-01 and is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added ip routing setting with the approved baseline by approving or reverting it.
